study_identification_part.si4_title: Charting brain growth and aging at high spatial precision

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The abstract explicitly states the objectives: assembling a large reference cohort to build lifespan brain charts using normative modeling and demonstrating clinical utility by application to a transdiagnostic psychiatric sample. This covers both research questions and the purpose of applying normative modeling (individual-level deviations and clinical relevance).
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "We assembled a reference cohort of neuroimaging data from 82 sites (N=58,836; ages 2-100) and used normative modeling to characterize lifespan trajectories... We showcase the clinical value by applying the models to a transdiagnostic psychiatric sample (N=1985)..."

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: Criteria related to data quality and completeness are described (presence of demographics, T1-weighted MRI, FreeSurfer outputs), and both manual and automated QC procedures are specified. Data sources are cited across many public datasets and sites, and final sample sizes are reported (e.g., N=58,836; site-level Ns in supplements). However, detailed inclusion/exclusion criteria for each contributing dataset and explicit reasons for all exclusions beyond QC thresholds are deferred to original publications, so eligibility criteria are not fully specified within this article.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "Inclusion criteria for the full sample were based on participants having basic demographic information (age and sex), a T1-weighted MRI volume, and Freesurfer output directories... Freesurfer image analysis suite (version 6.0) was used..."; "We adopted an automated QC procedure that quantifies image quality based on the Freesurfer Euler Characteristic (EC)... removing samples in the tail of the distribution..."; "Data from 82 sites were combined... Many sites were pulled from publicly available data sets including ABCD, ABIDE, ADHD200, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP..., IXI, NKI-RS, Oasis, OpenNeuro, PNC, SRPBS, and UKBiobank... Full details regarding ... acquisition protocols can be found in the publications associated with each of the studies."

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The modeling explicitly includes age, sex, and site as covariates; site variation is modeled using fixed effects. This addresses both covariate handling and multi-site effects.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: "Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) with likelihood warping was used to predict cortical thickness and subcortical volume from a vector of covariates (age, sex, and site)... Site variation was modeled using fixed effects..."

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: "Normative modeling was run using python 3.8 and the PCNtoolkit package (version 0.20). Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) with likelihood warping was used... a B-spline basis expansion... 'sinarcsinsh' warping function... Site variation was modeled using fixed effects... A fast numerical optimization algorithm (L-BFGS) was used..."
